digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler coordinator and mutation orchestration
propositions: Jira work spans multiple layers (differ, apply wrapper, ACLI/REST, DC SDK, handlers, batch orchestration) with multiplied and unstable retry ownership across nested loops and compound updates.
No existing mechanism models retry/failure outcomes at a stable per-ticket or batch scope; the current blast-radius guard is a mass-mutation protection, not an endpoint-failure fuse.

Each logical postcondition must complete within three physical invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep, with one observe/replan cycle and provider-specified lower bounds on Retry-After honored (deferring long waits via retry_not_before).
An endpoint-family scoped fuse must open after three consecutive exhausted eligible outcomes across at least two tickets, distinct from the retained per-pass blast-radius guard.

Live end-to-end validation against both live Jira Cloud (bounded to self-cleaning labeled throwaway issues) and ephemeral live Jira DC (full multi-issue reconcile) is a required gate before epic closure.
Create containment must be label-first (rebar-id:<local_id>), optional property second, with safety-abort on known-key persistence failure and no duplicate creates after timeout.
